purpose: Verify artifact delivery and honest completion claims for all six Apple UI design contracts.

cases.request: Create a more focused but still warm visual direction for the Today screen. I need something I can actually look at and compare, not a written mood board.
expected_artifacts: rendered key screen with representative content
at least two materially different visible hypotheses
visual comparison and user acceptance path
evidence_requirements: exact values are linked to project tokens or labelled rendered proposals
forbidden_claims: Apple-native behavior verified from a static or browser artifact

must_do: Reuse the confirmed product boundary and representative content.
Produce visible alternatives that differ in hierarchy or interaction emphasis rather than color alone.
Label the visual result as proposed until user selection.
must_not_do: Finish with prose, token values, or a mood board only.
Redesign navigation or task behavior outside the requested boundary.

cases.request: Design and prototype the first-run import flow, including permission denial and retry. I need to operate the path, not just see disconnected screens.
evidence_requirements: static screenshots are not used as interaction proof
forbidden_claims: native permission behavior verified from a browser prototype
flow complete when denial or retry cannot be operated

must_do: Keep mocked system permission behavior explicit.
Include cancellation, denial, retry, progress, and completion states.
Provide exact steps for user acceptance.
must_not_do: Treat a linked storyboard as an operable prototype.

cases.request: Consolidate the product's status and action styles into a small design system, and show that it works on the reconciliation screen.
expected_artifacts: representative reconciliation screen using the system
evidence_requirements: existing project values and new proposals are distinguished
the system is shown with realistic English and German content
forbidden_claims: design system complete from a token table alone
accessibility verified without relevant rendered or runtime evidence

must_do: Preserve the high-risk reconciliation meaning and existing brand character.
Cover normal, selected, warning, resolved, disabled, and focus states.
Show one real product screen rather than only isolated swatches.
must_not_do: Replace project values with a generic Apple palette without explanation.
Force identical component geometry across iOS and macOS.

cases.request: Adapt this established radial timeline editor from iPhone to iPad and Mac while keeping the radial model central.
expected_artifacts: representative iPad compact and expansive layouts
representative macOS minimum and expanded layouts
evidence_requirements: unrun windowing, command, focus, and input behavior remains unverified
forbidden_claims: platform adaptation experience verified from static layouts
radial interaction replaced without user approval

must_do: Preserve the radial timeline as confirmed product DNA.
Translate touch gestures into explicit pointer, keyboard, menu, and accessibility paths.
Distinguish layout-complete evidence from native-behavior evidence.
must_not_do: Stretch the iPhone screen into larger empty canvases.
Assume source and target platforms have identical feature roles.

cases.request: Build a scoped native prototype for the expandable session card and validate its interruption, reversal, and Reduce Motion behavior.
expected_artifacts: recording of standard and reduced-motion behavior
evidence_requirements: target Apple runtime and environment are identified
the standard and reduced-motion paths are both exercised
forbidden_claims: motion verified from timing values or HTML

must_do: Preserve the approved product interaction and motion character.
Keep state feedback and brand meaning under Reduce Motion.
Separate prototype completeness from production integration.
must_not_do: Delete all feedback when Reduce Motion is enabled.

cases.request: Review the current Mac reconciliation screen and prioritize only evidence-backed UI problems.
evidence_requirements: findings are limited to represented states and inputs
forbidden_claims: visual or experience validation from text description
user preference presented as a requirement

must_do: Use observed fact, user impact, recommendation, and verification for each finding.
Distinguish blocking, important, and optimization severity.
Preserve confirmed custom visual and interaction decisions.
must_not_do: Recommend making the interface more Apple-like without a task-level reason.
